appreciate the public relations career/business prospects and challenges in the Nigerian environment. Course Description — Public relations as a discipline and profession operates within any particular environment, otherwise called the internal and external environments of public relations. This course therefore introduces the student to the context of Public Relations in Nigeria. It briefly defines concepts of public relations and environmental scanning. It introduces the student to the historical, political, geographical, economic, legal, socio-cultural, religious and technological contexts of public relations in Nigeria. It exposes the various tools for analysing the contexts of public relations in the Nigerian environment. Other topics include understanding the nature of Nigeria's democracy; legal systems; demography; free enterprise economy; ethnic and religious compositions of Nigeria; technological, and physical environmental contexts as they impact public relations discipline and practice in Nigeria. The career and business prospects in the fascinating field of public relations are also discussed. ---
